meta.description: The ORVIBO Security Kit: a Zigbee Mini gateway, a door & window sensor and a motion sensor that alert you at once when a door opens or someone moves about the house, and flash the lights to scare burglars off.
suit_page.ss_txt: The doors and windows are shut and locked, yet home alone you still don't feel quite safe. Is peace of mind really that hard to find?
suit_page.st_txt: Three devices that guard your home together
suit_page.sf_title2: A reminder to shut doors and windows, the first step in prevention
suit_page.sf_txt: If you didn't lock the door or forgot to shut a window, the door & window sensor fitted on it senses in real time whether it is open or shut and reminds you to close it. Security starts at the source: prevention comes first.
suit_page.sf_title3: Arm your home in one tap and know at once if something's wrong
suit_page.sf_txt2: Once you set up “Armed mode” in the ORVIBO Home app, if a door or window is opened or the motion sensor picks up someone in the hallway, the alarm goes off at once and your phone gets an alert.
suit_page.ss_title: Lights that keep flashing send burglars running
suit_page.ss_txt2: To stop a burglar going any further, you can also have the lights flash nonstop, the TV turn itself on and more, so it looks like someone is home and the burglar runs off.
suit_page.se_title: More devices linked, your home guarded from every side
suit_page.si_txt: Temperature and humidity in real time
suit_page.data_source_tips: *Data from ORVIBO's lab; results may vary slightly with the measuring method.
